title: Cleaning crew
question: Who cleans up the debris?
intervention: Watch the Recyclers on the debris patch, then open the resource history to see the debris total.
predictedTradeoff: Recyclers turn debris into body and energy. The debris is finite, so a group that grows fast may run out.
confounds: Dead organisms add debris of their own, so the debris total can rise as well as fall. Only debris eaten counts toward the goal.

completion.journalStamp: Watched a cleaning crew eat debris
